// diagnostic

E2113

`{option}` is pinned to `{value}`, so the flag can't change it.

What

`{option}` is pinned to `{value}`, so the flag can't change it.

Why

`b.pin(.option, .Value)` in `fn build` fixes a build option for every build; a flag may only change values that aren't pinned.

Fix

Remove the flag, or remove the pin in `fn build`.
